value.rationale: Complete natural invariant for every prime and every cardinality, not an arbitrary slice or a single computation. The p=5 universal/failed/universal pattern is a genuine nonmonotonic obstruction; the theorem supplies a clean, usable prime-square lift mechanism and a sharp p>=7 threshold with congruence-dependent two-sum boundary.
